name: Via Brabantica, Mechelen - Brussels
description_md:
Via Brabantica, Mechelen - Brussels is a waymarked hiking route located in BE. This hard trail covers a distance of 34.5 km with 295 m of ascent and 263 m of descent.

The walk takes about 9.4 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and belongs to the international waymarked hiking network. Along the way, the route passes Brussels within 200 m, Manneken Peace within 500 m, and Conservatoire royal de Bruxelles - Koninklijk Conservatorium Brussel within 900 m.
